precision: configure_matmul_precision(): bf16 autocast, reduced-precision bf16 reductions off

test_split.opened: once per 3 GB checkpoint, after this manifest; an unchanged technical retry is allowed, a rescoring after any change is not
test_split.metric: BPB over the full 16 MiB test split, 8 KiB document windows, same scorer and precision as validation
test_split.intervals: document-clustered paired bootstrap, scripts/diag/paired_gain.py, 2000 draws, seed 0
test_split.primary_pair: M-P6 against M-BPE16K (best validation BPB of each registered family), each seed reported
test_split.ablation: M-P6-nohash (not eligible as the primary byte model)
test_split.exploratory: XS-BPE50K and XS-BPE16K, added after the registered validation results; marked separately
test_split.quality_tolerance: |delta BPB| <= 0.03 and <= 3% (relaxed band 0.05 and 5% reported separately)
test_split.selection: no model, pair or setting is chosen from test results; any test-driven analysis is labelled exploratory and never replaces the primary result

tasks.data: zero-shot, full validation splits: PIQA 1838, HellaSwag 10042; lm-eval-style templates (src/blt/tasks.py format_candidates)
tasks.primary_metric: accuracy with each candidate's NLL divided by its UTF-8 byte length including the leading space (accuracy_byte_normalised; not identical to the harness acc_norm)
tasks.aggregate: equal-weight mean of the PIQA and HellaSwag accuracies
tasks.primary_pair: M-P6 against M-BPE16K, reported per seed
tasks.retention: drop of the aggregate <= 2 points; a point estimate within 2 points is reported as such, non-inferiority needs the one-sided 95% lower bound of the paired difference >= -2 points
tasks.above_chance: both models >= 55% on PIQA and >= 30% on HellaSwag, each 95% interval excluding uniform chance (50% and 25%); otherwise the task-retention claim is unsupported
tasks.scoring_check: before the run: independent full-sequence minus context NLL on 50 fixed items per task, for BPE50K, BPE16K and a byte model, agreement within 1e-3 nats per candidate in FP32

decode.status: secondary protocol details specified after the validation and prefill results and functional smoke tests, before any full decode measurement (late specification)
decode.primary_batched_cell: M-P6 against M-BPE16K, batch 8, 8 KiB prompts, 256 requested output bytes per row, distinct prompts per row; threshold >= 1.20x, interval excluding 1
decode.primary_latency_cell: M-P6 against M-BPE16K, batch 1, 8 KiB, 256 bytes; each model in its fastest correct non-speculative mode, chosen on calibration prompts separate from the timed ones; threshold >= 1.10x; comparator worded 'fastest tested non-speculative BPE implementation of the paired model'
decode.measure: post-prefill completion latency and batch x 256 / elapsed seconds; generated bytes and overshoot reported separately; completion polled on the device every 8 native steps for both families
decode.sessions: three sessions x 30 timed requests for the primary cells, crossed bootstrap as for prefill; one session for the diagnostic cells (batch 32, 2 KiB, eager/device/graph, XS pairs)
decode.parity: >= 512 greedy output bytes per row against the reference path before timing
